title: X-LAB RS7
notes: International official page: US$2,099 for the 105 mechanical build with free shipping in the contiguous U.S.; a 105 Di2 build is also offered but its price was not displayed. Specification for the mechanical build: XDS carbon frame (Toray T800), XDS carbon fork (Toray T-700, 100×12 mm thru-axle), Branta carbon integrated cockpit, aero carbon seatpost, Shimano 105 RD/FD-R7100 with ST-R7120 and BR-R7170, CS-R7101 11–34T, Branta alloy power-meter crankset 52/36T with 24 mm steel spindle, BSA 24 mm bottom bracket, SM-RT70 160/160 mm rotors, Branta C45 Base carbon wheels with stainless spokes, Branta R301 30C tires, maximum tire clearance 32C and 8.49 kg for size L. Six sizes XS–XXL; stack/reach XS 526/360, S 535/370, M 546/380, L 561/390, XL 574/400, XXL 602/412 mm.
